sentences.en: I must calculate how much money I'll spend next week.
sentences.zh: 我必须计算下周我会花多少钱。

sentences.en: It is difficult to calculate the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 很难预测这次选举的结果。

sentences.en: Is it true that you calculated this without a calculator?
sentences.zh: 你真的没有用计算器就算出这个结果了吗？

phrases.zh: 计算...的数量/数量的多少

senses.zh: 计算,估计,打算，计划,旨在vt.预测，推测
